title: Band-9 Samples: Do you play any games? [Why/Why not?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 9 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 1 question: “Do you play any games? [Why/Why not?]” Sample 1: Yes Female Male Indeed, I play video games quite regularly. I believe they’re more than just a form of entertainment, they’re a form of art. The intricate storylines, stunning graphics, and complex mechanics make each game a unique experience. Plus, it’s a great way to unwind after a long day. Sample 2: Yes Female Male Yes, our family enjoys playing games together, especially during family gatherings. Our favorite is Monopoly; it’s a fun way to teach the younger ones about money management. Besides, it gives us a chance to strengthen our bond, share laughs, and create lasting memories. Sample 3: Yes Female Male Yes, I’m an avid chess player. The reason behind my fascination is the intellectual stimulation it provides. Unlike many other pastimes, it’s not just about luck but strategy and critical thinking. It’s like a battle of wits, making every move crucial. The thrill of predicting your opponent’s moves and forming a counter-strategy is immensely rewarding. Sample 4: Yes Female Male Yes, I do play games, specifically virtual reality (VR) games. They offer an immersive experience that traditional games can’t match. It’s fascinating how you can explore different worlds and live out various scenarios. It’s like a form of escapism, allowing me to take a break from reality. Sample 5: Yes Female Male Indeed, I engage in games, notably those with an educational bent. I see them as a dynamic alternative to conventional learning techniques. They render learning more hands-on, captivating, and enjoyable. For instance, I use language learning games to bolster my vocabulary and pronunciation. Sample 6: No Female Male I would love to engage in games, but unfortunately, my hectic schedule doesn’t allow me to. Between my full-time job and my studies, I barely have any leisure time. When I do get some free time, I prefer to use it for relaxation or catching up on some much-needed sleep. Sample 7: No Female Male I’m not particularly fond of board games or video games, instead, I’m a huge fan of outdoor activities. There’s something about feeling the wind against your face and the adrenaline rush you get from sports like mountain biking or rock climbing. They not only keep me physically fit but also mentally refreshed. Sample 8: No Female Male To be candid, I don’t partake much in games. I don’t particularly relish competitive situations, which are often a component of many games. I’m more inclined towards collaborative activities where the emphasis is on collective effort rather than one-upmanship. Sample 9: No Female Male I must admit that I don’t play games of any sort. It’s not that I don’t appreciate them, but I have a strong inclination towards maintaining a healthy lifestyle. I’ve read studies linking prolonged gaming with sedentary habits and poor health outcomes, so I prefer to spend my free time in more physically active pursuits. Sample 10: No Female Male To be completely honest, I don’t play games. I’m an introverted person and value my alone time. I prefer solitary activities, like reading, which allow me to delve into different worlds, expand my horizons, and explore ideas at my own pace.
